WooCategorieMapping.title: WooCategorieMapping
WooCategorieMapping.description: A Woo informatiecategorie mapping: a pure per-type configuration row binding one publishable object type (identified by schema slug or payload kind, meeting-agenda, besluitenlijst, minutes, decision, motie, toezegging, raadsinformatiebrief, regeling) to a TOOI concept URI from the waardelijst woo-informatiecategorieen, so the DiWoo decorator (imperative DiWooMetadataService, out of this declarative-core scope) can resolve the Woo informatiecategorie of a payload at publish time. Mappings are per-type DEFAULTS: a per-object override is captured at publish time and stored in that publication's own diwoo block with provenance default|override, the mapping object itself is NEVER edited by a publish action. A mapping whose objectType schema is not installed (sibling change not yet landed) is INERT: it never blocks import, publication, or the coverage report; the coverage view lists it as 'type not installed' rather than a compliance gap. CONSTRAINT: this schema carries only public configuration data, no secrets, no credentials (ADR-064; any push Source credentials live in OpenConnector). Mappings have NO lifecycle (design: 'mappings have no lifecycle; publication lifecycle stays owned by public-publication'), deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle. objectType is required and unique per row; OR has no cross-object unique constraint, so uniqueness is a review/validation concern and the index sorts by objectType so duplicates are immediately visible.

objectType.title: Object type
objectType.description: The publishable object type this row maps, identified by schema slug or payload kind. Required and unique per row (OR has no cross-object unique constraint: uniqueness is a review/validation concern; the index sorts by objectType so duplicates are immediately visible). A row whose type schema is not installed is inert.

informatiecategorie.title: Informatiecategorie (TOOI URI)
informatiecategorie.description: TOOI concept URI from the published waardelijst woo-informatiecategorieen. Pattern-validated against the https://identifier.overheid.nl/tooi/ prefix server-side (schema validation rejects any URI outside the TOOI namespace, the 'Invalid TOOI URI refused' scenario). SEEDS SHIP AN OBVIOUS SHAPE-ONLY PLACEHOLDER (segment c_PLACEHOLDER_...); the implementation task copies the exact concept URI verbatim from the published waardelijst: invented ids never ship (design 'TOOI URIs are data, never code'). Required.

informatiecategorieLabel.title: Informatiecategorie label
informatiecategorieLabel.description: Human-readable label of the TOOI informatiecategorie, shown in the admin mapping UI and the publish dialog. Statutory Dutch term kept (informatiecategorie). Required.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this mapping is active. Only an active mapping is used by the decorator to resolve a payload's informatiecategorie; an inactive mapping leaves the type unmapped and is counted by the coverage KPI. Required.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text notes on the mapping (e.g. provenance of the TOOI concept URI, sibling-schema dependency). Optional.

WooBestuursorgaan.title: WooBestuursorgaan
WooBestuursorgaan.description: A per-governance-body bestuursorgaan configuration ('admin settings shape'): binds one GovernanceBody to its bestuursorgaan TOOI organization identifier (the gemeente code convention, e.g. gm0344, the SAME org-identity convention the records-management-archiving MDTO archiefvormer uses: one identity convention across archiving and Woo). The DiWoo decorator (imperative, out of this declarative-core scope) stamps diwoo.bestuursorgaan from this override when publishing an object of the matching body; the instance-wide default bestuursorgaan is app config managed in the admin Woo section (not an OR object). CONSTRAINT: public configuration only, no secrets (ADR-064). One row per governance body; governanceBody is required and unique. No lifecycle (config object).

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this bestuursorgaan identifier applies to (per-body override). Required and unique per row (OR has no cross-object unique constraint: uniqueness is a review/validation concern).

governingBody.title: Bestuursorgaan (TOOI id)
governingBody.description: TOOI organization identifier of the publishing governance body: the gemeente code convention (e.g. gm0344), the same convention the records-management-archiving MDTO archiefvormer uses. Statutory Dutch term kept (bestuursorgaan). SEEDS SHIP AN EXAMPLE id only; set the real bestuursorgaan identifier of this body at implementation. Required.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional human-readable label of the bestuursorgaan, shown in the admin Woo section. Optional.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this per-body bestuursorgaan override is active. When inactive, the decorator falls back to the instance-wide default app config. Required.
